original_record.version_evidence: version/help inspected before study; no per-trial model inference
original_record.model_selection: CLI inherited default; exact model not reported by this collector
original_record.sandbox_configuration_reason: Codex 0.145.0 on Windows downgrades workspace-write to read-only when its Windows sandbox is disabled. Set native restricted-token sandbox per invocation while ignoring user config; retain workspace-write and managed requirements.
original_record.usage_semantics: Latest cumulative thread usage from a fresh one-turn process. Do not sum cache/reasoning subsets into input/output. All-zero/missing is unavailable.
original_record.operation_count_semantics: Unique completed command_execution, mcp_tool_call, collab_tool_call, and web_search items. File-change items are separate. These are exported activity counts, not every internal raw API/tool call.
original_record.tool_output_chars_semantics: Unicode code points in exported aggregated_output strings of unique completed command_execution items only. Not tokens, bytes, full untruncated output, or all tool types. Total is null when any command lacks an output string; observed partial sum and missing count are retained.
original_record.isolation_limit: Fresh process/fixture and ignored user config do not prove absence of every inherited instruction or global skill.
